card.name: Words just before a condition or time clause
card.fires_on: Words and punctuation that sit right before a clause about when or under what condition something happens, such as 'or' before 'after the expiration date', or a comma before 'when you are walking'. Also fires after a dose number like 20 before 'mg or'.

modes.label: Joiner before a condition
modes.description: 'or', 'in', or a comma that leads into a when/after/in the event of clause.
modes.example: Discard 13 months after opening the foil pouch, when the dose counter displays 0,<< or>> after the expiration date on the product,

modes.label: Dose unit before an alternative
modes.description: The unit mg after a dose number, just before 'or decrease to' another dose.
modes.example: Increase to 20<< mg>> or decrease to 5 mg based on

modes.label: Word before a time phrase
modes.description: A verb or noun that is followed by 'at the time of' or a similar timing phrase.
modes.example: are<< obtained>> at the time of expected peak concentration.

card.writes: It seems to favor odd word endings and suppress words meaning 'time' or 'during', so it is not clearly about output.
card.plain: It lights up on small words that come just before a 'when' or 'in the event of' type phrase.
